caption: The drawing depicts a single high boot with an attached wooden leg support. The lower section of the object consists of a dark brown-black leather boot with a rounded square toe, a medium-high chunky heel, and a slightly worn appearance at the sole and toe area. The boot extends upward, transitioning into a tall, elongated leg support structure made of wood, which has a lighter brown coloration and visible wood grain texture. The wooden section is fitted seamlessly into the boot and has cutouts at the top edge. The leg support shows vertical striations and shading that accentuate its cylindrical form. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with minor spots and marks, and the object is centered, occupying the majority of the image. The drawing includes attendee-study details that appear to be handwritten near the boot in faint, small letters.
title: Shoemaker's Sign Board
